name: Architectural Control Committee
purpose: Reviews applications for exterior changes so the neighborhood stays consistent and property values hold.

purpose: Runs the pool season and the community events calendar — craft days, the ice cream socials, the food truck nights.

name: Welcome Committee

name: Maintenance Committee
